name: bloom-night-overlay-tokyo
perspective: regional night view with bloom glow
description: Add NASA GIBS public VIIRS city-lights imagery over Tokyo and enable the built-in bloom post-processing stage so city lights produce a visible glow. Tests scene.postProcessStages.bloom and bloom uniform tuning without Cesium ion imagery entitlement.
prompt: Create an eval-stable public viewer with OpenStreetMap as the explicit base layer. Dim the base layer so it does not wash out the night view, for example set baseLayer.alpha around 0.15-0.25 and brightness around 0.2-0.35 after creating it. Add NASA GIBS VIIRS CityLights imagery from `https://gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov/wmts/epsg3857/best/wmts.cgi` as an overlay using WebMapTileServiceImageryProvider with layer `VIIRS_CityLights_2012`, style `default`, format `image/jpeg`, tileMatrixSetID `GoogleMapsCompatible_Level8`, and maximumLevel 8. Set the night overlay's alpha = 0.9-1.0. If the public night layer is too low contrast in the screenshot, add subtle semi-transparent yellow/white city-light ellipses over Tokyo/Yokohama as a visual anchor for bloom, while still keeping the GIBS layer present. Then enable Cesium's built-in bloom stage with `const bloom = viewer.scene.postProcessStages.bloom`; set bloom.enabled = true and tune bloom.uniforms with restrained values such as contrast around 64, brightness around -0.6 to -0.9, glowOnly = false, delta = 1, sigma = 3.78, stepSize = 5, and scene exposure around 0.5-0.8 if needed. Frame Tokyo straight-down at high altitude: viewer.camera.setView({ destination: Cesium.Cartesian3.fromDegrees(139.6917, 35.6895, 1200000) }). The camera should see a dark Tokyo night-lights map with bloom glow on city lights, not a blank blue tile and not a pale daylight basemap. Do not use IonImageryProvider or default ion imagery.
expected_behaviors: Adds a public NASA GIBS night-imagery overlay layer
Tunes bloom uniforms (at minimum contrast or brightness or delta or sigma)
Sets bloom.enabled = true (or relies on add() default enabling)
Frames the camera over Tokyo at 35.67 N, 139.65 E, around 500,000-1,500,000 m altitude
Camera pitch is straight down or close to it
Dims the OSM base layer or lowers exposure so the result remains a dark night-lights view
If needed, adds subtle bright city-light ellipses over Tokyo/Yokohama so bloom has visible light pixels to affect
visual_expectations: A dark night view of the Tokyo metropolitan region with city lights clearly visible and glowing softly outward due to the bloom stage. Bright city centers should bleed into surrounding darker areas while ocean and rural land remain dark enough to read as night. The visual assessment uses a four-shot cardinal panorama (north, east, south, west) from the settled viewer state; the subject should remain understandable across the panorama, and grading considers all screenshots together.
